messages:
kevin: Heads up — e2e caught a weird double-counting of quota when the new policy-proxy shim is enabled. Repro steps in thread.
maria: ugh, that sounds bad. any error logs?
kevin: yes, brief repro:
```
# client sends request
X-Client-Id: acct-123
X-Routing-Policy: tiered
# proxy inserts X-Policy-ID and forwards to backend
X-Policy-Id: p-987
# SDK also appended X-Policy-Id for backwards compat
```
result: backend sees two policy headers, telemetry pipeline attributes policy twice -> quota double-charged.
anna: is it deterministic or only under high concurrency?
kevin: reproducer is deterministic with the shim + sdk v1.12.0 under any concurrency. saw it locally with curl + proxy. logs show proxy adds header when absent, but SDK fallback path also appends when it doesn't see a negotiated header.
sam: so two sources of truth: proxy synthesis and sdk fallback. was the fallback added in 1.12.0 to handle old proxies?
maria: yeah fallback was intentional for older internal infra. but we should've used a single negotiated header name.
jordan: quick question — does the console telemetry already dedupe on header value? or it just aggregates per header occurrence?
lisa: console ingestion groups by request id and policy id, but our quota pipeline uses header presence counts from the API gateway, which doesn't dedupe per request currently.
kevin: steps I'm proposing:
1) hotfix SDK to prefer proxy-negotiated header `X-Redwood-Policy` and do not synthesize if proxy indicates support via `X-Policy-Negotiate: 1`.
2) temporary guard in proxy to not add header if client already supplied `X-Redwood-Policy`.
3) telemetry/backfill alert to detect >1 policy header per request and surface on dashboard.
4) release patch v1.12.1 and feature-flag rollout.
maria: agree. also add a unit test that simulates header-injection race.
anna: +1. can we also add a small migration in console to show a one-off count of affected requests last 72h? we need to inform customers if billing impacted.
sam: i'll own the SDK change. ETA EOD today for PR. will add feature flag `sdk.policy_respect_proxy` default true in config so we can opt-out if needed.
jordan: i'll add the dashboard tile and alert rule — will pin to the routing/telemetry dashboard. need event schema: header_count > 1 -> fire.
lisa: ops: we should not auto-refund yet. wait until we quantify impact. I'll run a query once the dashboard exists and block refunds until PM alignment.
kevin: devops-bot: create incident tracker for this (low to medium, affects billing accuracy)
devops-bot: Incident INC-2026 created by kevin — link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026
maria: thanks. SDK PR link when ready pls, i'll review fast. also add changelog note about header negotiation and backwards compat implications.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 — includes tests and flag. marking for review.
kevin: rolling plan: hotfix -> canary to 10% -> monitor policy-header-count -> 100% if green. rollback path is to re-enable sdk synthesis via flag.
anna: any customer-facing comms needed right away?
lisa: we'll draft a short support note explaining \"possible duplicate quota counts observed; fix rolling out; we will follow up with any billing adjustments if needed.\" keep it minimal for now.
jordan: added dashboard panel and alert rule draft: will share in #dashboards channel for visibility.
maria: perfect. thanks everyone. follow-ups: sam will merge SDK patch, kevin will coordinate proxy guard, jordan will finalize dashboard, lisa will prepare support note.
kevin: thanks — tagging @maria @sam @jordan @lisa. I'll post postmortem draft after we finish triage.
